text:
alex: Deploybot blocked canary publish for eu.gcr.io/redwood/worker:canary-2026-07-01 — HOLD. registry rejected manifest list due to mixed manifest schema versions.

deploybot: [automated] publish-hold: manifest schema mismatch detected across platform entries. summary:
```
manifest list entry linux/amd64 -> schemaVersion: 2, mediaType: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json
manifest list entry linux/arm64 -> schemaVersion: 1, mediaType: application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v1+prettyjws
registry response: 400 Bad Request - EU mirror enforces v2-only manifests
```

jamie: that's surprising — our ARM build should produce v2. Which builder handled the arm64 image?

riley: found it: runner-legacy-03 did the cross-arch push. it still has old docker toolchain that emits schema v1 for some manifest permutations. the global push merged entries and produced a mixed list.

alex: options: 1) promote the previous digest that EU already accepts; 2) rebuild arm64 with modern runner and push a normalized v2-only manifest list; 3) attempt to convert the arm64 entry in-place (unsupported/risky). opinions?

jamie: customers want canary today. low-risk is promote previous digest in EU and schedule normalized republish tonight.

riley: agreed. previous known-good digest is `sha256:5b9f3c2a1d4e6f7890abcde1234567890fedcba9876543210fedcba12345678a`. we can pin EU traffic to that digest until we republish a clean v2 manifest list.

deploybot: action recorded: publish held. recommended plan:
- pin -> eu.gcr.io/redwood/worker@sha256:5b9f3c2a1d4e6f7890abcde1234567890fedcba9876543210fedcba12345678a
- schedule normalized republish using runner-modern-04 at 23:00 UTC change window
- update release notes and post PSA to #support: "Canary deferred in EU due to mixed manifest schema; serving pinned to previous digest"

release-coordinator: 23:00 UTC change window approved. I'll add note to public draft and ping support.

jamie: i'll open a quick change to release manifest to point EU mirror at the pinned digest (no retag of the existing broken manifest).

riley: i'll re-run the arm64 build on runner-modern-04 and use `manifest-tool` to construct an explicit v2 manifest list, then run cosign attestation. sample commands i'll run:
```
manifest-tool push from-spec v2-manifest-spec.yml --all-platforms
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign worker:canary-2026-07-01
```

ajex: (typo) alex: no manual edits to the old digest allowed. create a new tag for the rebuilt image and request canary again.

jamie: also removing runner-legacy-03 from arm64 pool and adding a CI gate so any runner emitting schema v1 fails the publish step.

release-coordinator: INF-3030 filed for mirror-agent acceptance rules and runner inventory. attaching manifest samples and registry error.

alex: thanks. marking thread resolved when deploybot reports EU canary green or when pin is live in production. :white_check_mark:
